---
title: "Practicals and exercises"
toc: true
---

The 31 practicals provide a complete initial teaching collection for both harmonized outlines. Each includes a biological question, assumptions, runnable examples, interpretation, exercises and suggested answers. All numerical inputs are hypothetical; no biological downloads or additional analysis packages are required. The examples teach the methods and their limits rather than claiming production-pipeline qualification.

The 26 original sessions map to 24 shared practicals. Seven additional practicals strengthen sample identity, regularized prediction, microbiomics, phenomics, association, epigenomics and advanced-method reasoning.

## Run the practicals

Download or clone the [course repository](https://github.com/psoerensen/genomics-systems-bioinfo) and open `genomics-systems-bioinfo.Rproj`. Quarto uses R with knitr/rmarkdown to render the practicals. In the RStudio Terminal, for example:

```bash
quarto render tutorials/p09_rnaseq.qmd
```

You can also run the displayed chunks in order in a clean R session, starting in either the repository root or its `tutorials/` folder. The code locates the local teaching helpers in `R/`. These helpers and their hypothetical data model are part of the repository; a copied code fragment still needs those files. No biological download is required. Use the code folds to inspect each calculation and attempt exercises before revealing suggested answers.
